_note: Copy to ~/.claude/statusline.config.json, next to statusline.js. Each runner entry is { "label": shown on the status line, "process": the process name to look for }, checked machine-wide once a minute (tasklist on Windows, pgrep -f elsewhere). An empty list hides the runners line. Example for one GitHub Actions self-hosted runner: "runners": [{ "label": "runners", "process": "Runner.Listener" }]
